description: One row per New Approach Method (NAM). Modelled after NF/MC2 Tools tables. NAM type classification uses the New Approach Methods Ontology (NAMO) from the Monarch Initiative (https://github.com/monarch-initiative/namo). Governance fields follow Synapse/Sage portal conventions. Synapse table: syn75404716.

AccessRequirements.description: Description of any Synapse Access Requirements governing the underlying data.
AccessRequirements.title: Access Requirements

oneOf.description: Requires approval via Synapse Access Requirements.
oneOf.title: Controlled

oneOf.description: Temporarily restricted; will become open after embargo lifts.
oneOf.title: Embargoed

AcknowledgementStatements.description: Required attribution or acknowledgement text for data reuse.
AcknowledgementStatements.title: Acknowledgement Statements

DatasetId.description: Synapse Dataset entity ID. Blank for externally hosted datasets.
DatasetId.title: Dataset_id

DevelopmentStatus.description: Current development stage of the NAM.

oneOf.description: Method is no longer actively maintained.
oneOf.title: Deprecated

DevelopmentStatus.title: Development Status

DuoCode.description: Data Use Ontology (GA4GH DUO) codes restricting data reuse. Examples: GRU (General Research Use), HMB (Health/Medical/Biomedical), DS (Disease Specific).
DuoCode.title: Duo Code

EndpointsMeasured.description: Biological or chemical endpoints the NAM measures.
EndpointsMeasured.title: Endpoints Measured

License.description: License governing reuse of the underlying data (e.g. CC-BY-4.0).
License.title: License

NamId.description: NAM identifier(s) linking to the NAMs table (syn75404716).
NamId.title: Nam_id

NamoCategory.description: Top-level branch from the NAMO ontology. Examples: InVitroBiological, InSilico, InChemico.
NamoCategory.title: Namo Category

NamoClass.description: Specific class name from the New Approach Methods Ontology (NAMO). Examples: Organoid, OrganOnChip, QSARModel, PBPKModel.
NamoClass.title: Namo Class

NamoId.description: NAMO ontology term identifier. Format: NAMO:XXXXXXX.
NamoId.title: Namo_id

Organism.description: Organism(s) the NAM is derived from or applicable to.
Organism.title: Organism

PortalDisplay.description: Whether this record should be displayed on the public portal.
PortalDisplay.title: Portal Display

RelatedPublications.description: PubMed IDs of publications describing or using this NAM.
RelatedPublications.title: Related Publications

StudyId.description: Study identifier linking to the Studies table (syn75404711).
StudyId.title: Study_id

TissueOrCellType.description: Tissue or cell type(s) used in the NAM.
TissueOrCellType.title: Tissue Or Cell Type
